title: Investment Administrator
description:
The Company: A well-established Wealth Management business based in York who are looking to appoint an experienced Investment Administrator to join their Portfolio Management team. Supporting Portfolio Managers and Financial Advisers, this is a varied opportunity suited to someone with previous investment administration or wealth management experience who enjoys working in a technical, client-focused environment with responsibility for investment transactions, portfolio administration and operational support.
- Office Location: Central York
- Working Setup: Office-based
- Hours: Full-time (Mon-Fri)

Package: Circa £30k base + bonus & full company benefits
- Benefits: Pension, 4xDIS + healthcare and study support towards professional exams
- Holidays:25-days + stats

The Role: A varied Investment Administration role providing administrative and operational support to the Portfolio Management team, ensuring the accurate processing of investment transactions and the delivery of an excellent client experience. Key accountabilities include:
- Process investment transactions accurately and within agreed service standards
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date client and investment records across internal systems
- Prepare investment documentation, portfolio administration and client correspondence
- Monitor outstanding transactions and proactively progress cases through to completion
- Assist with investment reporting, portfolio valuations and cash movements
- Support settlement activities and reconciliation processes
- Liaise with custodians, investment platforms and third-party providers to resolve queries
- Provide administrative support to Portfolio Managers and Financial Advisers
- Respond to client enquiries in a professional and timely manner
- Assist with maintaining operational records, registers and quality checking procedures
- Ensure all documentation and processes remain FCA compliant and aligned with Consumer Duty principles
- Support Anti-Money Laundering, GDPR and wider regulatory requirements
- Identify and escalate operational risks or potential client issues where appropriate

The Person: Previous experience within Investment Administration, Wealth Management or Financial Services is essential, alongside a good understanding of investment transactions, client servicing and back-office administration. The successful individual will possess excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities whilst maintaining high levels of accuracy. It's an opportunity that will someone who enjoys administration work, placing trades and is keen to establish themselves in a career within investment management.

What next? Please send CV applications to Chris at CB3 Associates Ltd and they will be reviewed inside 24 hours.

title: Customer Service Assistant
description:
Customer Service Assistant £13.45 per Hour Part-Time Immediate Start

Are you passionate about delivering exceptional customer service? Do you enjoy meeting people from around the world and working in a unique historic setting?

HR GO Recruitment is recruiting for enthusiastic and friendly Customer Service Assistants to join the Visitor Experience Team at one of York's most popular heritage attractions for the busy summer season.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work in a unique environment, welcoming visitors, supporting memorable experiences, and helping create a positive and lasting impression for guests from across the globe.

- £13.45 per hour
- Weekly pay
- Part-time hours
- Seasonal opportunity through to the end of September
- Pension scheme
- Cash health plan
- Virtual GP access
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
- PerkBox discounts platform
- Staff discounts
- Discounts with selected local businesses
- Free on-site parking (subject to availability)
- Full training provided

Working Hours
- Part-time position
- Typically 3 to 5 shifts per week
- Average shift length of 5 hours
- Day shifts between the hours of 9:15am and 5:00pm
- Weekend working required on a rota basis
- Occasional evening work may be required to support events

The Role

As a Customer Service Assistant, you'll play a key role in ensuring every visitor enjoys a safe, welcoming and memorable experience.

Key Responsibilities:
- Welcoming visitors and providing a friendly, professional first impression
- Assisting with visitor enquiries, ticketing, events and activities
- Supporting visitor experiences throughout the attraction
- Managing visitor flow and queues during busy periods
- Promoting visitor services, events and experiences
- Delivering exceptional customer service
- Supporting visitors with accessibility requirements and individual needs
- Maintaining clean, safe and accessible public areas
- Identifying and reporting health, safety or security concerns
- Assisting with emergency procedures and evacuations when required
- Providing first aid support following training
- Working collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Experienced in a customer-facing role
- Friendly, confident and approachable
- Passionate about delivering outstanding customer service
- Comfortable engaging with people of all ages and backgrounds
- Positive, proactive and able to remain calm under pressure
- A strong team player with a flexible approach
- Aware of health and safety responsibilities
- Comfortable using computer systems and Microsoft Office applications

Desirable Experience
- Hospitality, tourism, retail, leisure or visitor attraction experience
- Till or ticketing system experience
- Additional language skills
- An interest in history, heritage, architecture or tourism
- Experience supporting events or public-facing activities

Please Note

This role will involve:
- Standing for extended periods
- Working both indoors and outdoors
- Accessing all public areas of the attraction, including heights and confined spaces
- Participating in duties involving climbing steps (full training provided)
- Working during weekends and peak visitor periods

Apply Today

If you're passionate about people, customer service and creating memorable visitor experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and a member of the HR GO Recruitment team will be in touch.

title: Recruitment Administrator
description:
Are you an organised and proactive Recruitment Administrator looking for your next opportunity in the Eastfield area? Do you enjoy supporting people through the recruitment process, keeping everything organised behind the scenes and being the person everyone can rely on? Are you looking for a varied role where you can develop your HR and recruitment administration skills within a growing business?

If so, this Recruitment Administrator job in the Eastfield area could be exactly what you're looking for.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a successful and growing organisation where you'll become an integral part of a friendly Head Office team. Working closely with senior managers, you'll play a key role in supporting recruitment, onboarding and general business administration, helping to ensure an excellent experience for both candidates and employees.

This is a varied role where no two days are the same. We're looking for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced office, uses their initiative, thrives on being organised and isn't afraid to muck in wherever support is needed.

What the Recruitment Administrator job involves

As the Recruitment Administrator, you'll provide administrative support across recruitment, HR and the wider business, including:
- Managing recruitment administration from advertising vacancies through to onboarding new employees.
- Communicating with candidates throughout the recruitment process to ensure a positive candidate experience.
- Preparing employment documentation and maintaining accurate employee records.
- Coordinating interviews, inductions and onboarding activities.
- Maintaining recruitment and HR systems, ensuring information is accurate and up to date.
- Supporting training administration and maintaining employee records.
- Producing reports, updating spreadsheets and preparing business documentation.
- Responding to telephone and email enquiries professionally and efficiently.
- Coordinating meetings, diary management and general Head Office administration.
- Supporting managers and colleagues with a range of administrative tasks across the business.
- Assisting with business improvement projects and identifying opportunities to improve administrative processes.
- Providing additional office support whenever required to ensure the smooth running of the Head Office.

Skills required

We're looking for someone who enjoys working in a busy office and takes pride in delivering excellent administrative support. You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience within a Recruitment Administrator, HR Administrator, Office Administrator or Business Support role.
- Experience supporting recruitment, onboarding or HR administration would be advantageous.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Excellent communication skills with a confident and professional telephone manner.
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Word, Excel and Outlook.
- The ability to prioritise a varied workload and meet deadlines.
- A proactive attitude with the confidence to work on your own initiative.
- A flexible approach and willingness to support colleagues across the wider business.
- A calm, professional manner with the ability to handle confidential information appropriately.
- Someone who enjoys working as part of a close-knit team and building positive working relationships.
